title: Speed of the Shissar
wikitext:
{{Spellpage| | spellname = Speed of the Shissar | spellicon = R | description = Fills your target with the power of the Shissar, increasing attack speed, agility, endurance regeneration, and armor class for 30 minutes. There doesn't seem to be a level requirement to receive the buff. This spell does not stack with most other haste spells such as [[Wonderous Rapidity]] (will not overwrite) or [[Visions of Grandeur]] (will overwrite). It also does not stack with certain AC buffs such as [[Call of Earth]] or the [[Yaulp]] line of spells; though it stacks fine with cleric AC buffs such as [[Bulwark of Faith]], [[Aegis]] and [[Aegolism]]. | classes = This spell is cast by NPCs only. | items_with_effect =
